thread:
incident-bot: Paging oncall for traces export degradation in prod -> Honeycomb EU API errors. @alex @maya :rotating_light:
Alex Kim: on it, paging in. seeing alert: trace-exporter errors spiking, 5xx/429 from honeycomb-api-prod-eu
Maya Patel: confirmed. traces missing from dashboards, span ingest latency increasing. dashboards for customer A & B show large gaps.
Priya Rao: adding context — we rolled out exporter v2.3.1 22:10 UTC and started seeing backpressure around 22:18 UTC.
Sam Nguyen: logs show repeated errors: 
```
2026-03-15T22:18:23Z exporter/honeycomb WARNING: api error status=503 body="Service Unavailable"
2026-03-15T22:18:23Z exporter/honeycomb DEBUG: retrying request, attempt=3
2026-03-15T22:18:25Z exporter/honeycomb ERROR: rate_limit_exceeded status=429 quota="ingest"
```
Nora Li: queue length for trace-shippers has ballooned to ~1.1M spans pending, memory climb on shippers.
Maya Patel: customer impact estimate?
Alex Kim: P1 for observability (user-facing dashboards degraded, but core inference unaffected). Affected customers: those with trace-forwarding to Honeycomb EU and NewRelic connectors enabled.
Priya Rao: Honeycomb support contacted (case #HC-10294) — they report elevated 5xxs in EU region and a partial routing issue. Support ETA 30m.
Sam Nguyen: immediate mitigation: throttle exporter and enable local on-disk buffering to avoid OOMs. I'm going to flip primary exporter to queued mode.
Alex Kim: runbook command to disable live exports to Honeycomb and route to local buffer: 
```
# disable direct export
redwoodctl export set-target --env prod --name honeycomb-eu --mode queued
# increase local buffer
redwoodctl config set trace.buffer.size --env prod 2000000
```
Maya Patel: applying now. will monitor queue drain and memory.
incident-bot: Action recorded: exporter toggled to queued mode at 22:24:12 UTC by maya.
sre-bot: Metric alert muted for trace-exporter 15m to prevent noise.
Priya Rao: additionally, we should enable the NewRelic fallback sink (s3 -> NR ingest) for  customer accounts that had NR configured. I'll start that job.
Sam Nguyen: starting incremental flush from in-memory queue to S3 archive to preserve spans for later replay. command: 
```
redwoodctl trace flush --env prod --target s3://trace-archive/prod/2026-03-15 --chunk-size 10000
```
Nora Li: noting customers with elevated error rates: cust-A, cust-B, cust-C. Support notified 22:26 UTC.
Maya Patel: Support message: "We're temporarily throttling trace exports due to Honeycomb EU API errors. Traces will be preserved locally and replayed once vendor resolves. No inference errors expected." sent to #support-customer-alerts. :white_check_mark:
Alex Kim: monitoring: queue still rising but at slower rate. memory stable for now. Honeycomb updates say they have a routing fix in deploy; further update in 20m.
Priya Rao: preparing incident timeline and impact notes for stakeholders. Need to capture exact window of missing traces: 22:18 - TBD.
Sam Nguyen: reminder: keep an eye on backpressure signals — if queue > 2M we may need to scale trace-shippers horizontally. Auto-scale policy currently at 8 -> 16 nodes.
Maya Patel: scaling up to 12 now.
incident-bot: On-call handoff scheduled at 2026-03-15T23:00:00Z to next oncall (Nora).
Nora Li: I'll take IC for the overnight window once handoff hits. leaving notes in the thread.
Alex Kim: quick checklist for handoff to Nora: 1) confirm Honeycomb resolution and replay schedule 2) keep exporters queued until vendor confirms stability 3) validate replay integrity against sample traces 4) update customers in #support if replay completes.
Priya Rao: postmortem owners: infra+observability. I'll draft.
Maya Patel: update from Honeycomb at 22:45 UTC: "We have mitigated the routing instability in EU and are accepting traffic, but recommend a gradual ramp for high-volume senders."
Sam Nguyen: recommendation — keep queued mode for 30m, then gradually resume direct exports at 10% traffic increments while watching 5xx/429.
Nora Li: acknowledged, will run ramp after handoff window and report.
Alex Kim: logging timeline and participants. I'll create incident channel #inc-1997654321 for postmortem artifacts.
incident-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-1997654321 (auto).
Maya Patel: thanks team. brief retrospective: need better alerting for exporter partial failures vs total down; also ensure vendor replay runbook is ready.
Priya Rao: adding action items to ops board: vendor-retry-policy, export backpressure autoscale, replay verification tooling.
Nora Li: handoff complete, taking over IC duties. leaving this thread pinned for overnight watchers. :crescent_moon:
